StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: Persisted portfolio project override or custom client showcase managed by the agency owner.

projectId.description: Identifier matching the target built-in or custom portfolio project.

kind.description: Whether this document overrides a built-in portfolio project or defines a new custom project.

overrideData.description: Override structure for heroImage, logo, brandGuidelinesPdf, addedAssets, addedGallery, replacedAssets, and removedAssetUrls.

customProject.description: Complete custom ProjectItem payload when kind is 'custom'.

ownerUid.description: UID of the verified owner who created this record.

StudioAsset.title: StudioAsset
StudioAsset.description: Persisted portfolio visual or PDF asset stored durably in Firestore.

assetId.description: Unique identifier for the studio asset.

projectId.description: Portfolio project identifier this asset belongs to.

kind.description: Media type of the persisted asset.

dataUrl.description: Inline compressed data URL for single-document images or compact PDFs.

chunkCount.description: Number of ordered chunks in subcollection when a PDF exceeds single-doc threshold.

ownerUid.description: UID of the verified owner who uploaded the asset.

StudioAssetChunk.title: StudioAssetChunk
StudioAssetChunk.description: Ordered base64 slice for large brand-guidelines PDF documents.

/studioProjects/{projectId}.description: Published custom projects and per-project overrides for built-in portfolio clients.

/studioAssets/{assetId}.description: Durable cloud storage for uploaded portfolio images and brand PDFs.

/studioAssets/{assetId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Ordered payload chunks for multi-part Brand Book PDFs.
